mentions.name: Specter
mentions.description: A plugin for Ghidra that brings semi-deterministic AI agent workflows to Ghidra. It adds a terminal-like interface to Ghidra's code browser where users can chat or run DSL queries. Its SQL engine is being replaced with Apache Calcite.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a plugin for Ghidra called Specter that aims to bring semi-deterministic agent workflows to Ghidra. It adds a terminal like interface to Ghidra's code browser where you can chat or run DSL queries.
